caption: This shio broth ramen features a golden-yellow, clear, glossy soup with floating ingredients. In a white ceramic bowl, halved egg, dark green nori, tender pale pink chashu pork, and golden-brown menma are served on a dark wooden table with visible grain.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly glossy surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, with thin noodles submerged and floating ingredients visible.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, sliced, slightly translucent pieces with a soft, fibrous texture.
A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk surrounded by a firm white, with a slightly textured surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, unadorned rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
